name: Bendcount
description: Set the lead hand a forearm's length from the rear hand on the shaft and feel where the blade's weight balances.

name: Tight Cutbelly
description: Hold the shaft crosswise at chest height with both hands so a blow lands on the wood and not the body.

name: Narrow Longedge
description: Cut straight down from the shoulder so the curved edge meets the target along its belly.

name: Backward Reave
description: Slide the rear foot up as the lead foot advances a pace and keep the shaft level through the move.

name: Pushing Curvetip
description: Beat the opponent's weapon sideways with the flat of the shaft so it leaves its line.

name: Hard Guardlug
description: Prod the tip of the curved blade straight at the throat or belly and draw it back.

name: Cutternote
description: Turn the hips with the blade held out and sense the arc the curved edge will cover.

name: Cutterblow
description: Swing the curved edge flat and low across the opponent's shins in a single turning sweep.

name: Blunt Curvecut
description: Sweep the blade belly across the ribs at belt height with the full turn of the body behind it.

name: Slicefall Strike
description: Rise onto the toes and carry the sweep to neck height so the edge passes under the chin.

name: Cutterdash
description: Bring the blade back along the same arc after a miss so the return stroke catches the foe closing in.

name: Solid Ferrulecap
description: Catch an opponent's swing on the shaft just below the blade and bear it down against the ground.

name: Sharp Edgeswing
description: Back away while sweeping the blade in wide arcs so that a pursuer cannot close the distance.

name: Cuttercount
description: Hold the blade point out at arm's length and learn the distance at which a cut will just land.

name: Narrow Windrake
description: Slide the rear hand to the end of the shaft and cut from the longest reach the grip allows.

name: Narrow Bladespine
description: Draw the shaft in close as the foe presses and cut with the heel of the blade at short range.

name: Steady Tangheel
description: Hold the blade tip steady at throat height to keep a smaller opponent from stepping inside the reach.

name: Ready Glaiveblade
description: Lift the long shaft in front of the body to push an incoming blade up and away.

name: Glaivereview
description: Spin the blade in slow circles at the wrist to learn how its weight travels around the hand.

name: Reavebump
description: Wheel the blade over the shoulder in a full circle and finish with a downward cut.

name: Quick Longcut
description: Cut across the target and pull the blade toward you so the curved edge saws through as it passes.

name: Upward Glavesocket
description: Press the curved edge into the target and push it forward along the cut so the curve slices.

name: Planted Guardlug
description: Trace a figure eight in front of the body so the shaft and blade turn aside anything that enters it.

name: Downward Spineedge
description: Cut with the back of the hand leading and draw the blade across the opponent's far side.

name: Upward Glaiveblade
description: Stop the wheel and snap the tip forward so the circling blade becomes a straight thrust.

name: Catching Curvetip
description: Spin the shaft quickly through the grip so the butt end cracks across a reaching hand.

name: Hooding Tangheel
description: Plant the feet wide with the knees bent so a shove or a pull cannot move the stance.

name: Reaveskitter
description: Glide forward with the lead foot skimming the ground so the blade stays level while the body advances.

name: Backward Ferrulecap
description: Turn on the ball of the front foot to face a new opponent without lifting the shaft from its line.

name: Bendhit
description: Drive off the rear foot into a long lunge and land a cut as the lead knee settles.

name: Sideways Bladespine
description: Skip back two paces keeping the blade tip pointed forward so the retreat covers itself.

name: Glavesocket Lid
description: Shuffle sideways off the line of an attack and brush the blow past with the shaft.

name: Stiff Edgeswing
description: Jab the iron-capped butt of the shaft into the opponent's belly when the blade side is blocked.

name: Stiff Slicefall
description: Ram the shaft forward in both hands against the chest to push the opponent back a pace.

name: Catching Spineedge
description: Pin a grasped weapon between the shaft and the hip so the foe cannot pull it free.

name: Sharp Cutbelly
description: Swing the butt end low behind the body to knock a trailing leg out from under the foe.

name: Resting Curvetip
description: Raise the shaft flat above the head so a downward blow lands on the wood between the hands.

name: Hitching Windrake
description: Reverse the glaive end for end in the hands so a foe misjudges which end will strike next.

name: Stepping Longcut
description: Plant the butt on the ground and swing the body around it to change facing quickly.

name: Gentle Cutbelly
description: Draw a thin warmth of qi along the curved edge so it bites a little deeper than steel alone.

name: Cutterdrop
description: Chop down with the warmed edge so the cut lands harder than a plain cut of the same swing.

name: Lowered Glavesocket
description: Run a pulse of qi through the shaft as it meets a blade and turn the blow aside cleanly.

name: Benddrop
description: Thrust with qi gathered at the tip so it enters the target's guard more easily than bare steel.

name: Easing Reave
description: Pair a breath with each step forward so the qi stays even and the blade does not waver.

name: Glaivelid
description: Tap the opponent's weapon with a flick of qi from the blade's spine so the grip loosens.

name: Soft Ferrulecap
description: Draw breath as the blade is drawn back and feel the reach of the sweep gather in the arms.

name: Gnawing Longedge
description: Breathe out through the whole sweep so the qi in the edge rises and falls with the swing.

name: Single Curvecut
description: Cut upward from the low guard on a single in-breath so the edge climbs along the foe's body.

name: Raised Guardlug
description: Hold the breath and the shaft rigid against a heavy blow, then release both together.

name: Sharp Spineedge
description: Take a second short breath at the end of a sweep and bring the blade back along its path.

name: Sideways Curvecut
description: Let the body drift a half pace in the direction of the sweep so the blade keeps its momentum.

name: Hitching Slicefall
description: Lean the shaft against the opponent's weapon on one long breath until their arms tire and sag.

name: Bendstrike
description: Chain three cuts to the rhythm of three breaths, each flowing from the one before it.

name: Gentle Tangheel
description: Hold the blade level at chest height and feel the line from edge to target stay true.

name: Reaveblow
description: Thrust along the held line without dipping the tip so the qi at the point meets the target squarely.

name: Glaiveblow
description: Cut along a straight line as if running on a rail so no force is lost to a wandering edge.

name: Solid Bladespine
description: Slide the shaft along the line of an incoming thrust and ease it off to the side.

name: Bendamble
description: Glide backward along the same line you advanced on so the blade never leaves its guard.

name: Warm Glaiveblade
description: Learn by touch which face of the curved blade cuts and which is the blunt spine that bears a parry.

name: Cutterstrike
description: Lay a thin sheen of qi on the blade's belly and cut so the curve opens a long shallow wound.

name: Cuttercowl
description: Meet a blow with the flat of the spine backed by qi in the shaft and press it off.

name: Wide Longedge
description: Drop the tip suddenly at the end of a thrust and slash down across the foe's forearm.

name: Locking Windrake
description: Beat the heel of the blade against a raised weapon so the qi jars it from the hand's line.

name: Crookhusk
description: Let a blade slide off the curve of the glaive and ride it out past the body.

name: Backward Glavesocket
description: Turn the edge toward the target while taking half a pace so no cut starts from a standing pause.

name: Spineedge Review
description: Feel when a cut has gone past safe reach and shift the weight back before the foe can answer.

name: Firm Edgeswing
description: Step into a long lunge and cut from the full reach of the shaft with the rear hand at its end.

name: Reavetrot
description: Drag the rear foot up after a lunge so the body returns to a balanced guard in one motion.

name: Solid Glaiveblade
description: Bring the shaft back across the body the instant a cut ends so no opening is left.

name: Bendblow
description: Prod the tip at the pursuer's face while stepping back so the reach itself keeps him off.

name: Tripping Edgeswing
description: Rap the shaft against an arm that has crept inside the reach and knock the attack off line.
